conf.description: VMware NSX Manager audit/system log, syslog-kv: hand-built RFC 5424 + structured-data + 3-branch body parser (http/manager/policy key=value, cli CMD:), masks New value/CMD text, keeps _raw per the direct recommendation.

conf.comment: vmware-nsx/manager-audit/syslog-kv. No Elastic integration or Cribl Pack parses NSX appliance audit logs, so this is a hand-built RFC 5424 + structured-data + body-grammar parser. Received directly as RFC 5424 syslog on facility local6. Branches the message body on subcomp (http/manager/policy key="value" grammar vs cli CMD: line) per the work order's explicit 3-branch requirement.

functions.description: record scope and, for the api-pull variant, that it is the same grammar as the syslog feed
split the RFC 5424 header (PRI, timestamp, hostname, procid, msgid), the [nsx@6876 ...] structured-data element, and the free-text message body
repeating key="value" extraction of the structured-data params (audit, comp, subcomp, level, username, euser, reqId, entId, update, errorCode) into dynamically-named fields

repeating key="value" extraction of the audit body (UserName, ModuleName, Operation, "Operation status", "New value") - the name pattern allows embedded spaces because two of these keys are two words; harmless no-op on cli-branch bodies that don't match this grammar

cli-branch (subcomp="cli") records carry a bare CMD: line instead of the key/value body; the appended duration is not split out separately since the work order gives no delimiter for it (documented gap)
compute every derived field (severity scale, outcome vocab, boolean casts, length-capped New value/CMD text with truncation flags) from ORIGINAL vendor names before the batched rename (ORDER MATTERS)
batch every clean-named mapped field into its ECS/custom target
set Cribl's canonical _time from the RFC 5424 header timestamp - never target @timestamp directly (constraint 1)
redact password/secret/key-shaped nodes per recommendations.direct.cribl, across every field the parser materialized (raw AND parsed copies) so a masked value cannot leak from _raw
remove the two space-named working fields that eval.remove cannot target literally (awkward-name limitation)
drop remaining redundant working fields and tag the dataset - _raw is deliberately KEPT per recommendations.direct.cribl (low-volume, individually significant)
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
